interpretation.observed: two independently built high-tail residents using the same manual application-startup/foreground-replay architecture failed to restore application diagnostics until power-cycle
interpretation.preserved_prior_fact: the separate 2026-08-26 high-tail retention probe remains valid: code copied to FEBFF9F0..FEBFFBFB executed a marker and then the exact stock application entry 0x20880 reappeared
interpretation.retrospective_static_correction: both failed residents route stock startup/foreground calls through a C call0(address) helper; RH850 ABI passes address in r6, unlike the stock direct JARL sequence, so the failures do not qualify an ABI-preserving resident replay
